secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for server-side AI features (captions, hashtags). Get it from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key for AI inference (captions, hashtags, hooks). Get it from console.groq.com.

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_URL
secrets.description: LiveKit server URL (wss://...) for real-time audio/video streaming. From your LiveKit project dashboard.

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_API_KEY
secrets.description: LiveKit API key for generating stream tokens. From your LiveKit project dashboard.

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_API_SECRET
secrets.description: LiveKit API secret for generating stream tokens. From your LiveKit project dashboard.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram bot token for the central admin/moderation console. Create a bot via @BotFather.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID
secrets.description: Numeric Telegram chat/user ID of the platform admin (authorizes bot commands). Get from @userinfobot.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for sending email verification links on signup. From resend.com.

secrets.name: EMAIL_FROM
secrets.description: From address for verification emails, e.g. 'Pulse <no-reply@example.com>'. Must be a verified Resend sender.
